architectural_notes: Existing admin system already present in the app; use it to gate access and display admin list
known_issues: Download button (Google Sheet link) currently accessible to non-admin users

existing_features.title: Restrict access to the Conceptmachine Google Sheets download link so that non-admin users cannot see the download button and cannot obtain the Google Sheets URL from the frontend bundle or runtime state.
Add an admin-only section in the Profile page that lists all current admins (at minimum, their principals; optionally also show a display name when available).

Update frontend data-fetching (React Query hooks) to support the new backend endpoints for (1) fetching the admin-only download URL and (2) fetching the admin list, with appropriate loading and error states on the Profile page.

new_feature_requests.summary: Restrict Google Sheet download button/link to admins only (non-admins must not have access to the link)
Add admin visibility in profile page: admins can see who else is an admin
